class.name: SfxEvent
class.brief_description: One playable sound of an [SfxBank] - FMOD's event.
class.description: A timeline of [member clips], any number of parameter-driven [member automations], [member parameter_modulations] of gain/pitch/unit size, and [member triggers] that start and stop it from parameters. [method SfxPlayer.play] starts one instance of it.

members.member: Whether the event's own envelope ([member attack], [member decay], [member sustain], [member release]) gates all its voices.
Seconds from silence to full gain.
Clip groups that follow a parameter instead of the clock (e.g. engine samples over rpm).

Clips on the event's timeline: a [constant SfxClip.TRIGGER_TIMELINE] clip starts when the instance's time reaches its [member SfxClip.offset], a [constant SfxClip.TRIGGER_SUSTAIN] one when the instance is stopped without [code]immediate[/code].
Seconds from full gain to [member sustain].
The mixer track of a clip without one. Made by the editor for a new event; without one such a clip plays at unity.
The name the event is played by.
Mappings of parameters to gain, pitch or unit size of every voice; results multiply.
Factor on the pitch of every voice of the event.
Whether a [method SfxPlayer.play] while the event plays starts a second instance ([code]true[/code]) or replaces the playing one.
Seconds of fade-out after a non-immediate stop.
Overrides of the 3D voices' place and attenuation.
How far into its stream every clip but a bookend starts, as a fraction of the stream: emitters playing one recording in step comb-filter into a ring.
What starts and stops the event from parameters of the player.
